item.title: Qatar U-17 lose 2-0 to Egypt at the World Cup
item.description:
Qatar lost 2-0 to Egypt on Sunday in the second round of Group A at the FIFA U-17 World Cup, at the Ibrahim Khalfan pitch in Aspire Zone. Ahmed Safwat and Khaled Mokhtar scored in the 2nd and 33rd minutes. Qatar stay on 3 points in third place, Egypt move second on the same tally, and Greece lead the group with 6 points.
Sources: Qatar News Agency (QNA) https://qna.org.qa/en/News-Area/News/2026-11/22/fifa-u-17-world-cup-qatar-egypt-wins-against-qatar-in-group-a-round-2-match · Al Raya https://www.raya.com/2026/11/22/%D9%83%D8%A3%D8%B3-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B9%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85-%D8%AA%D8%AD%D8%AA-17-%D8%B9%D8%A7%D9%85%D8%A7-%D9%85%D9%86%D8%AA%D8%AE%D8%A8%D9%86%D8%A7-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%88%D8%B7%D9%86%D9%8A-%D9%8A%D8%AE%D8%B3%D8%B1-%D8%A3%D9%85%D8%A7%D9%85-%D9%86%D8%B8%D9%8A%D8%B1%D9%87-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D8%B5%D8%B1%D9%8A-%D9%81%D9%8A-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AC%D9%88%D9%84%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AB%D8%A7%D9%86%D9%8A%D8%A9 · Youm7 https://www.youm7.com/story/2026/11/22/x/7628634

item.title: Lusail Circuit declares readiness for the Formula 1 Qatar Grand Prix
item.description:
Lusail International Circuit said on Sunday it is ready to host the Formula 1 Qatar Airways Qatar Grand Prix from 27 to 29 November, a week before the event. A press conference with partners including the Tournament Security Force, Visit Qatar and Ooredoo reviewed infrastructure, operations and fan experiences. The race is the 22nd and penultimate round of the world championship.
Sources: Qatar News Agency (QNA) https://qna.org.qa/en/News-Area/News/2026-11/22/lusail-international-circuit-highlights-preparations-for-formula-1qatar-airways-qatar-grand-prix-2026 · Al Raya https://www.raya.com/2026/11/22/%D8%AD%D9%84%D8%A8%D8%A9-%D9%84%D9%88%D8%B3%D9%8A%D9%84-%D8%AC%D8%A7%D9%87%D8%B2%D8%A9-%D9%84%D8%A7%D8%B3%D8%AA%D8%B6%D8%A7%D9%81%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%81%D9%88%D8%B1%D9%85%D9%88%D9%84%D8%A7-1 · Al Sharq https://www.al-sharq.com/article/22/11/2026/%D8%AD%D9%84%D8%A8%D8%A9-%D9%84%D9%88%D8%B3%D9%8A%D9%84-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AF%D9%88%D9%84%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D8%AA%D8%B3%D8%AA%D8%B9%D8%B1%D8%B6-%D8%A2%D8%AE%D8%B1-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A7%D8%B3%D8%AA%D8%B9%D8%AF%D8%A7%D8%AF%D8%A7%D8%AA-%D9%84%D8%A7%D8%B3%D8%AA%D8%B6%D8%A7%D9%81%D8%A9-%D8%B3%D8%A8%D8%A7%D9%82-%D8%AC%D8%A7%D8%A6%D8%B2%D8%A9-%D9%82%D8%B7%D8%B1-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%83%D8%A8%D8%B1%D9%89-%D9%84%D9%84%D9%81%D9%88%D8%B1%D9%85%D9%88%D9%84%D8%A7-1-2026 · Qatar Tribune https://www.qatar-tribune.com/article/265808/latest-news/lusail-circuit-ready-for-formula-1-qatar-airways-qatar-grand-prix

item.title: Qatar Charity delivers 3,380 food baskets to 17,000 refugees in Djibouti
item.description:
Qatar Charity distributed 3,380 food baskets to refugee families in three camps in Djibouti, benefiting about 17,000 people, in coordination with the national refugee agency ONARS, it said on Sunday. The project covered 700 baskets in Markazi camp, 973 in Holl Holl and 1,707 in Ali Addeh; each basket feeds a family for a month as winter approaches.
Sources: Qatar News Agency (QNA) https://qna.org.qa/en/News-Area/News/2026-11/22/17000-refugees-in-djibouti-benefit-from-qatar-charity-relief-project · Al Raya https://www.raya.com/2026/11/22/%D9%82%D8%B7%D8%B1-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AE%D9%8A%D8%B1%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D8%AA%D8%AF%D8%B9%D9%85-17-%D8%A3%D9%84%D9%81-%D9%84%D8%A7%D8%AC%D8%A6-%D9%81%D9%8A-%D8%AC%D9%8A%D8%A8%D9%88%D8%AA%D9%8A · Gulf Times https://www.gulf-times.com/article/738775/qatar/qatar-charity-provides-food-baskets-to-thousands-of-refugees-in-djibouti

item.title: Qatar Central Bank governor discusses banking ties with Canadian finance minister
item.description:
Qatar Central Bank Governor and Qatar Investment Authority Chairman Sheikh Bandar bin Mohammed bin Saoud Al-Thani met Canadian Minister of Finance and National Revenue François-Philippe Champagne on Sunday. They reviewed bilateral cooperation, focusing on the financial and banking sectors.
Sources: Qatar News Agency (QNA) https://qna.org.qa/en/News-Area/News/2026-11/22/qatar-central-bank-governor-meets-minister-of-finance-and-national-revenue-of-canada · The Peninsula https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/22/11/2026/qatar-central-bank-governor-meets-minister-of-finance-and-national-revenue-of-canada

item.title: The Amir congratulates Lebanon’s president on Independence Day
item.description:
HH the Amir Sheikh Tamim bin Hamad Al-Thani on Sunday sent a cable of congratulations to Lebanese President Joseph Aoun on his country’s Independence Day.

item.title: Arab League and Arab Parliament condemn attack on Bahraini facility
item.description:
The Arab League on Sunday evening strongly condemned the attack on a civilian industrial facility in Bahrain, calling it a flagrant violation of the kingdom’s sovereignty, a dangerous escalation and a breach of international law and the UN Charter. The Arab Parliament called for an immediate end to the attacks, saying Bahrain’s security is an integral part of Arab national security. The UAE also condemned the renewed Iranian attack on Bahrain.
Sources: Gulf News https://gulfnews.com/world/mena/middle-east-conflict-bahrain-intercepts-iranian-attacks-as-tehran-prepares-14-oil-tankers-to-breach-us-naval-blockade-1.500756662 · News of Bahrain https://www.newsofbahrain.com/en/article/arab-parliament-condemns-iranian-attack-on-bahrain

item.title: Coalition intercepts Houthi ballistic missile fired at western Saudi Arabia
item.description:
The Saudi-led coalition said on Sunday air defences intercepted and destroyed a ballistic missile fired by the Houthis towards the Western Region, the day’s second interception after a drone launched at the Riyadh region was downed. The Western Region hosts key energy facilities, including the Yanbu oil export terminal. Saudi authorities say Houthi attacks have killed 26 people in the kingdom since September.
Sources: Free Malaysia Today (AFP) https://www.freemalaysiatoday.com/category/world/2026/11/22/saudi-led-coalition-says-it-intercepted-houthi-missile-in-western-region · Asharq Al-Awsat https://english.aawsat.com/gulf/5344154-coalition-destroys-houthi-missile-targeting-western-region

item.title: Digital economy contributes about 9% of Oman’s GDP
item.description:
Oman’s Ministry of Transport, Communications and Information Technology said on Sunday the digital economy contributes about 9% of GDP, and investment in the telecoms and IT sector has reached about OMR 1.33 billion since 2021. Omanis hold 72.41% of technical and leadership roles, and Omanisation in the sector stood at 46.36% as of mid-2026.
Sources: Qatar News Agency (QNA) https://qna.org.qa/en/News-Area/News/2026-11/22/digital-economy-in-oman-contributes-9-to-gdp · Times of Oman https://timesofoman.com/article/179475-omans-digital-economy-contributes-9-of-gdp

item.title: More than 310,000 take part in Dubai Run on Sheikh Zayed Road
item.description:
More than 310,000 people took part in Dubai Run 2026 on Sheikh Zayed Road on Sunday, according to Dubai Crown Prince Sheikh Hamdan bin Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum. The run started at 6.38am after a security sweep, and the road reopened to traffic shortly after 10am.
Sources: Gulf News https://gulfnews.com/uae/dubai-run-2026-indian-expats-bring-back-giant-uae-flag-this-time-even-bigger-1.500757031 · Khaleej Times https://www.khaleejtimes.com/uae/dubai-run-2026-live-updates

item.title: Dubai Ruler establishes Office of Special Affairs at the Ruler’s Court
item.description:
Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum, UAE Vice President and Prime Minister, in his capacity as Ruler of Dubai, on Sunday issued Law No. 16 of 2026 establishing the Office of Special Affairs at the Ruler’s Court of Dubai. He also issued Decree No. 13 of 2026 appointing Sheikh Rashid bin Dalmook bin Juma Al Maktoum as its Director General with the title of His Excellency.
Sources: Gulf News https://gulfnews.com/uae/mohammed-bin-rashid-establishes-office-of-special-affairs-appoints-director-general-1.500756939 · Emarat Al Youm https://www.emaratalyoum.com/local-section/other/2026-11-22-1.2105336

item.title: Egyptian crew foils three suspected piracy attempts in the Gulf of Aden
item.description:
Egypt’s Transport Ministry said on Sunday a crew of 21 Egyptian seafarers aboard the San Marino-flagged cargo ship GOLDEN JOY, captained by Ali Soliman, repelled three attacks by suspected pirate boats off Yemen on 17 November. The ministry denied the vessel was Egyptian or named “Cairo Light”. It said the crew changed course and increased speed while armed guards fired warning shots, with no injuries.
Sources: Youm7 https://www.youm7.com/story/2026/11/22/x/7628633 · Masrawy https://www.masrawy.com/news/news_egypt/details/2026/11/22/3082907 · Gulf News https://gulfnews.com/world/mena/middle-east-conflict-bahrain-intercepts-iranian-attacks-as-tehran-prepares-14-oil-tankers-to-breach-us-naval-blockade-1.500756662

item.title: Egypt condemns attacks on Benghazi port, stresses Libyan sovereignty
item.description:
Egypt said on Sunday evening it was following with grave concern the explosion that targeted Benghazi port in Libya, condemning all acts that undermine Libya’s security and stability or threaten its vital facilities. It stressed respect for Libya’s sovereignty and territorial integrity under international law.
Sources: Youm7 https://www.youm7.com/story/2026/11/22/x/7628778 · Sada El Balad https://www.elbalad.news/7190770

item.title: Egypt condemns drone attacks on Khartoum and a UN building
item.description:
Egypt on Sunday strongly condemned drone attacks on the Sudanese capital Khartoum and a United Nations building that killed civilians and damaged civilian facilities. It offered condolences to the victims’ families and firmly rejected the targeting of civilians and the premises of international organisations.
Sources: Youm7 https://www.youm7.com/story/2026/11/22/x/7628780 · Sada El Balad https://www.elbalad.news/7190774

item.title: Death toll in Qena road crash rises to 6
item.description:
The death toll from a collision between a heavy truck and a passenger car on the Qift–Quseir road in southern Qena rose to 6 on Sunday evening, including five members of one family: a couple, their two children and their 7-year-old granddaughter, as well as the driver. Security services have opened legal proceedings and prosecutors were notified.
Sources: Youm7 https://www.youm7.com/story/2026/11/22/x/7628708 · Masrawy https://www.masrawy.com/news/news_regions/details/2026/11/22/3082900 · Sada El Balad https://www.elbalad.news/7190559

item.title: Engineering panel recommends immediate evacuation of leaning building in Dakahlia
item.description:
An engineering panel from Mansoura University on Sunday recommended the immediate evacuation of a leaning building in Mit Ghazala village, Sinbillawein, according to Dakahlia Governor Tarek Marzouk. He said the owner’s claim to have fixed the tilt could not be relied on because the reinforcement was done without certified engineering supervision, and the university will issue a final technical opinion.
Sources: Youm7 https://www.youm7.com/story/2026/11/22/x/7628706 · Sada El Balad https://www.elbalad.news/7190651

item.title: Trump threatens to resume war on Iran after New Year
item.description:
US President Donald Trump told Fox News on Sunday he is inclined to resume the war on Iran after the New Year if no agreement is reached, saying the United States would sink Iranian ships that try to break the naval blockade. He described indirect talks as continuing without real results and accused Iran’s negotiators of stalling.
Sources: Emarat Al Youm https://www.emaratalyoum.com/politics/news/2026-11-22-1.2105379 · News of Bahrain https://www.newsofbahrain.com/en/article/trump-threatens-to-resume-war-on-iran · Gulf News https://gulfnews.com/world/mena/middle-east-conflict-bahrain-intercepts-iranian-attacks-as-tehran-prepares-14-oil-tankers-to-breach-us-naval-blockade-1.500756662

item.title: Sea drone attack hits Russian warship in Benghazi port
item.description:
A sea drone attack at dawn on Sunday hit a Russian vessel moored in Benghazi port in eastern Libya, causing an explosion and fire, according to the eastern-based government. Satellite imagery identified the ship as the Russian missile corvette Merkury and showed most of it capsized and sunk. Libyan sources said Libyan and Russian nationals were killed and that Libyan forces foiled a second attack.
Sources: Al Jazeera English https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/22/suspected-drone-strike-hits-russian-vessel-in-libya · Kyiv Post https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90861 · Youm7 https://www.youm7.com/story/2026/11/22/x/7628615

item.title: Drones kill 4 in Khartoum and damage UN premises
item.description:
Drone attacks blamed on the Rapid Support Forces killed 4 people in and around Khartoum early on Sunday and damaged UN premises while staff were inside. Three were killed in a house in northern Omdurman and a child in Jebel Aulia south of the capital. UN humanitarian coordinator Denise Brown said international law protects humanitarian personnel.
Sources: Al Jazeera English https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/22/rsf-drones-kill-four-in-khartoum · The Peninsula (Xinhua) https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/22/11/2026/4-killed-in-drone-attacks-across-khartoum

item.title: Zelenskyy urges US to release Patriots after deadly strike near Kyiv
item.description:
Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy on Sunday urged the United States to approve delivery of Patriot interceptors after a week in which Russia launched about 2,700 drones and 165 missiles. A Russian strike hit an apartment building in Dymer, north of Kyiv, causing part of it to collapse. Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha urged Europe to deprive Moscow of the resources sustaining its war.
Sources: Al Jazeera English https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/22/zelenskyy-urges-us-to-release-patriot-missiles · Kyiv Post https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90859

item.title: Indonesia sweets factory fire kills 3, leaves 36 missing
item.description:
At least 3 people were killed and 36 are missing after a fire at the Fonusa Agung Mulia sweets factory in Banten province near Jakarta, Indonesian authorities said on Sunday. A company representative said 300 workers were inside when the blaze started; four injured were taken to hospital, and firefighters were still working more than 12 hours later.
Sources: Al Jazeera English (AP) https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/22/indonesia-factory-fire-kills-three-36-missing · Times of Oman (DW) https://timesofoman.com/article/179443-dozens-missing-as-deadly-fire-hits-indonesian-candy-factory
